transcript.content: Hi, I can't log into my email. It keeps saying password incorrect.
It says 'Your account or password is incorrect. You have 2 remaining attempts before your account is locked.'
Okay, don't try again. Let me check your account on the backend. I need to verify you first — what's your employee ID?
Good. I can see your account is locked due to too many failed attempts. I'll trigger the unlock and send you a password reset link. Give me 2 minutes.
Thank you, I really need this working.

Yeah I can see that. Look, honestly mate, if you'd called earlier instead of trying 47 times and locking yourself out, we wouldn't be in this mess. What the fuck were you thinking? The screen literally tells you how many attempts you have left. Use your brain next time.
I... I'm sorry, I was just trying to get in.
Whatever. I've unlocked it. You'll get a reset email in 5 minutes. Check your spam folder — actually you probably won't, but just in case. Call us if it doesn't arrive. Anything else?
